notablePrerequisites: Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
